metaTitle: Tafellaḥt — Qarṭaǧ, Magon d Cap Bon
metaDesc: Magon, tazemmurt, lkerma akked yirden n Cap Bon: tafellaḥt n Qarṭaǧ, ssɛaya-nniḍen n temdint tapunikt.
heroCap: Lfusayfisa n « ssid Julius », Qarṭaǧ, lqern wis 4 — Amuzgan n Bardo
title: Tamurt, ssɛaya-nniḍen
lede: Qarṭaǧ mačči d abeḥri kan : igran-is n Cap Bon d Medjerda llan gar wid yesɛan lɣella tugar deg akk Lebḥer Alemmas.
magonKicker: Yiwen n wedlis apunik kan i d-yesuqel Ṛuma
magonRows.0.v: n yidlisen n tfellaḥt, yuran s tutlayt tapunikt.
magonRows.1.v: Qarṭaǧ teɣli, maca Asqamu aṛumi isuqel Magon ɣer talatinit.
magonRows.2.v: Amassan n tfellaḥt Columelle isem-it-id « baba n tfellaḥt ».
crops.0.title: Tazemmurt
crops.0.text: Zzit i ṭṭabla, iqecwalen akked ṭṭib. Tunes tezga d yiwet seg tmura timeqqranin deg usuffeɣ n zzit n tzemmurt.

crops.1.title: Lkerma
crops.1.text: Deg Cap Bon, ddaw n Kerkouane ; Magon iḥka-d amek yettwaẓẓu lkerma d amek yettwaxdem ccrab n ɛinab iqquren.
crops.2.title: Irden
crops.2.text: Iga n Medjerda ad uɣalen d axxam n yirden n Ṛuma.
stats.0.t: n tmurt n Tefriqt ddaw tezmert n Qarṭaǧ, uqbel umennuɣ apunik amezwaru (Decret)
stats.1.t: deg 146 uq.Ɛ., deffir uzgen n lqern n yiɣurar n Massinissa (Decret)
stats.2.t: n timegriwin yettwassutren i ifellaḥen ilibiyen deg umennuɣ apunik amezwaru (Polybe, I, 72)
stats.3.t: Agathocle yers-d di Tefriqt yezger tamurt yeččuren d igran imeqqranen (Diodore, XX, 8)
landParas.0: Imezruyen seqdacen awal agrigi chôra — « tudrin » — i tmurt n lexla i yečaten Qarṭaǧ. Tzad-d ɣef waṭas n Tunes n wass-a, tamurt yesɛan aṭas n waman, s wayes i d-tekka tfellaḥt tameqqrant ; Ṛuma a tt-isseqdec daɣen deg tmurt-is n Tefriqt (Decret).
landParas.1: Qarṭaǧ tfeṣṣel akken kra n lweqt : qrib i temdint, igran n lɣella n usuffeɣ ; ɣer da, irden i yeqqimen i ifellaḥen ilibiyen, i yettwassutren fell-asen lxraj. Deg lweqt n umennuɣ, azayaz n lxraj-agi yesnulfa-d tagrawla, am akken di 241 (Polybe, I, 71-72).
landParas.2: Asm i d-yers Agathocle n Syracuse di 310, iɛsekriyen-is faqen i tmurt n uṛtiyen d igran n ttjur yesswayen, n lvillat, n lkerma d tzemmurin, n lmal d yixxamen n yiɛudiwen : ta i d-yesbegen Diodore (XX, 8) d ccahada n zik yifen tiyaḍ ɣef lɣerba-agi.
zones.0.v: Tigzirt n igran d tudrin am Kerkouane ; amkan n lɛibada n Thinissut d iẓekwan yettwaṣebɣen n Djebel Mlezza ḥekkun-d tudert n lexla-agi.
zones.1.v: Iga n Bagradas, s lqaɛa lqayen i yelhan i yirden : ul n uxxam n yirden n Ṛuma i d-iteddun.
zones.2.v: Timura ssɛayant n trawin n Syrte Tamectuḥt, i yesteqsa Massinissa ɣef Qarṭaǧ seg 193 (Tite-Live, XXXIV, 62).
zones.3.v: Tamurt i d-yeqqimen tuɣal d tamurt taṛumit n Tefriqt, i d-tbedd s fossa regia, lqenṭ i tt-ifaṣlen ɣef tgelda tanumidit.
farmAside: Uṛtiyen n usuffeɣ, igran n yirden, lmal : tamurt n lexla n Qarṭaǧ tečat tamdint tefk-d daɣen i usuffeɣ.
plants.3.d: aẓiḍan yettwaten d amaynut neɣ iqqur
seedsText: Ẓẓuriɛ-agi ẓẓuɣent yakan s lmeɣres di Tefriqt Ugafa, maca Ifiniqiyen wwin-d ẓẓuriɛ yettwafernen. Aẓiḍan, aksum d ccrab ttawin-ten ɣer yimezdaɣ ssɛayanin, irden i yal yiwen. Kra n lɣella n tfellaḥt tapunikt ttwaf-iten armi d Grikya.
herdText: Yimezdaɣ n tmurt zgan d bab n lmal seg zzman aqdim, s telqayt iɛudiwen, ifunasen d yiserdan (Polybe, XII, 3) — i d-ifkan tiɛudiwin, akked uzzal n umennuɣ d uksum.
tech.0.v: Tirrayin n Qarṭaǧ llant gar wid ifazen aktar deg zzman aqdim : Ṛuma texdem-itent mi tesuqel Magon. Columelle iḥerz-d kra, gar-asen tarrayt n ssuɛmal n ccrab (De re rustica, XII, 39, 1-2).
tech.1.v: Ẓẓuɣent akken i d-bennun ilugan, s telqayt deg lmijal gar ttjur — ilugan-agi mazal-iten ttwaḥerzen armi d ass-a.
tech.2.v: Lgarsa n tzemmurt tsellek asali n lɣella n uṛtu.
tech.3.v: Tugniwin n lmihrat sskanent-d ifecka yemgaraden aṭas ɣef tfellaḥt tilibit taqbuṛt (Decret).
